questionText:
Consider three floating point numbers $A$, $B$ and $C$ stored in registers $\text{R}_\text{A}$, $\text{R}_\text{B}$ and $\text{R}_\text{C}$, respectively as per IEEE-754 single precision floating point format. The 32-bit content stored in these registers (in hexadecimal form) are as follows.

| $\text{R}_\text{A} = \text{0xC1400000}$ | $\text{R}_\text{B} = \text{0x42100000}$ | $\text{R}_\text{C} = \text{0x41400000}$ |

Which one of the following is FALSE?
explanation:
Step 1: Convert register values from IEEE-754 single precision format to decimal values.

The IEEE-754 single precision floating point representation consists of:
• Sign bit ($S$): 1 bit
• Biased Exponent ($E$): 8 bits (Bias = 127)
• Mantissa/Fraction ($M$): 23 bits

Value $= (-1)^S \times (1.M) \times 2^{E - 127}$

1. For Register $\text{R}_\text{A} = \text{0xC1400000}$:
• Binary: $1\ 10000010\ 10000000000000000000000$
• $S = 1$ (Negative)
• $E = 10000010_2 = 130 \implies \text{Actual Exponent} = 130 - 127 = 3$
• Mantissa = $0.1_2 = 0.5 \implies 1.M = 1.5$
• $A = -1 \times 1.5 \times 2^3 = -12$

2. For Register $\text{R}_\text{B} = \text{0x42100000}$:
• Binary: $0\ 10000100\ 00100000000000000000000$
• $S = 0$ (Positive)
• $E = 10000100_2 = 132 \implies \text{Actual Exponent} = 132 - 127 = 5$
• Mantissa = $0.001_2 = 0.125 \implies 1.M = 1.125$
• $B = 1 \times 1.125 \times 2^5 = 36$

3. For Register $\text{R}_\text{C} = \text{0x41400000}$:
• Binary: $0\ 10000010\ 10000000000000000000000$
• $S = 0$ (Positive)
• $E = 10000010_2 = 130 \implies \text{Actual Exponent} = 130 - 127 = 3$
• Mantissa = $0.1_2 = 0.5 \implies 1.M = 1.5$
• $C = 1 \times 1.5 \times 2^3 = 12$

Step 2: Check each option.
• Option A: $A + C = -12 + 12 = 0$ (True)
• Option B: $C = A + B \implies 12 = -12 + 36 = 24$ (False)
• Option C: $B = 3C \implies 36 = 3 \times 12 = 36$ (True)
• Option D: $(B - C) > 0 \implies (36 - 12) = 24 > 0$ (True)

Hence, option B is FALSE.
